page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c32g1.16xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance belonging to the ecs.gn7i family. It is powered by 64 dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 2.9 GHz on an x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 376.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 5.88 GB of RAM per core.

This instance features two NVIDIA A10 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 48 GB of VRAM. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps, managed under a KVM hypervisor.

Given the dedicated Intel Xeon processor allocation and dual NVIDIA A10 GPUs, this instance offers a resource-dense configuration for parallel computing tasks. It is qualitatively positioned as a specialized hardware class for workloads requiring significant graphics processing and parallel compute capabilities without the need for high-speed local NVMe storage. Suitable workloads include deep learning inference, mid-range AI model training, high-performance computing, 3D rendering, and video transcoding.
